picks.title: [단독] 앤트로픽, 한강 작가 책도 불법 다운받았다
picks.excerpt: 앤트로픽이 2021~22년 불법 다운로드한 목록에 한강 '소년이 온다' 등 한국 작가 작품 최소 15건이 포함됐고, 미 법원 합의에 따라 한강 등 국내 작가들에게 보상을 제안한 것으로 확인됐다. 웅진북센과의 실물 도서 구매 계약도 확인.
picks.rationale: Exclusive: at least 15 Korean works, including Han Kang's, are on Anthropic's pirated-books list, and Korean authors are now being offered settlement compensation. This brings the US settlement home to Korean writers.

picks.title: Why We're Banning AI
picks.excerpt: Under its new union contract, Current Affairs magazine adopted one of the strictest anti-AI policies in publishing, committing to remain 'handmade' and urging readers to demand the same of every publication they support.
picks.rationale: A publisher has written a strict AI ban into a union contract. It is a concrete policy other editorial shops and staff unions can copy.

picks.title: Guest Post – The Evolution of Eras: Agentic Discovery Makes Way for Agentic Consumption
picks.excerpt: Researchers are moving from using AI agents to find papers to letting agents read and consume them on their behalf — a shift that changes how publishers must format, license and present scholarly content.
picks.rationale: Shows the shift from AI agents finding papers to agents reading them for researchers, and what that means for how publishers format and license content. This is a practical design and licensing question, not a general hype piece.

picks.title: "AI가 읽을 책, 토큰으로 검색"…멘탯, 도서 데이터 거래 서비스 출시
picks.excerpt: 도서 라이선싱 플랫폼 멘탯이 AI 기업이 출판사 도서를 권수가 아닌 '토큰' 단위·예상 비용으로 검색하고 계약까지 진행하는 '멘탯 디스커버리'를 출시. 국내 출판사 90여곳, 약 3만4000종 계약.
picks.rationale: Mentat Discovery is a new product: AI firms search and license Korean publishers' books priced by token rather than by title. About 34,000 titles from roughly 90 publishers are already signed up, which makes it a licensing alternative to the bulk book-buying stories.

picks.title: EWC calls for a more ambitious stance within the Draft Report 2025/2180(INI): AI is not a tool
picks.excerpt: The European Writers' Council formally objects to the European Parliament's own-initiative draft report on cultural sectors in the age of AI treating generative AI as an 'opportunity', calling it a threat to writers' livelihoods.
picks.rationale: The European Writers' Council has formally answered the European Parliament's draft report on culture and AI. It is a primary position document on legislative text still being drafted, so it shapes where EU rules for authors go.

alternates.title: Why Are Publishers Suing Big Tech With One Hand and Embracing AI With the Other?
alternates.excerpt: Lit Hub's columnist, fresh off an Authors Guild panel on authorship and AI, asks how Big Five houses can sue AI firms over training data while quietly rolling generative tools into editorial, cover and marketing workflows.
alternates.rationale: Timely column, but commentary that overlaps Wired 10-10 'publishers quietly using more AI'.

alternates.title: 웹툰·웹소설을 AI 애니로…카카오픽코마 '탈웹툰' 승부수
alternates.excerpt: 카카오픽코마가 웹툰·웹소설 IP를 AI로 제작한 애니메이션으로 전환하는 사업을 새 성장동력으로 삼고, 올해 AI 애니메이션 80편 공급을 추진한다.
alternates.rationale: Strategy feature (series installment) rather than a discrete release; backup.

https://www.sedaily.com/article/20102152.new_action: New exclusive finding: at least 15 Korean works, including Han Kang's 'Human Acts', are confirmed on Anthropic's 2021-22 pirated-books list, and Korean authors are being offered settlement compensation. It also reveals Anthropic's physical-book purchase contract with Woongjin Booxen. This is distinct from the Kyobo 100,000-copy order (joongang 25469854, 10-15) and the used-book buying probe (joongang 25468823, 10-12).

https://www.m-i.kr/news/articleView.html.new_action: Product release: Mentat Discovery launched (token-priced book-data search and licensing for AI firms, about 34,000 titles from 90 publishers). The 09-30 story was only an interview with the CEO.

https://europeanwriterscouncil.eu/ewc_ow.new_action: New official position paper responding to the European Parliament's own-initiative draft report 2025/2180(INI). The 10-05 statement was about book shredding, a different topic.
